concerns.text: The chi‑square test for `translation_error` vs. `complexity_group` (H2) is defined on the `translation_error` flag, which is only populated for the sampled subset of 200 queries (where an optimal plan exists). The plan does not specify how missing values for the remaining queries will be handled, nor does it restrict the analysis to the sampled subset. Including queries with undefined `translation_error` would bias the test or require imputation, which is not described.
